about: Gaps found in audits of the indicator monitor. The build shows every open one in the checks each day until it is closed. Close an item only with the commit or change that fixed it. Source: claude/Monitor_gap_audit.md in the project (9 October 2026), plus later findings.

gaps.short: readings do not conclude on exposure
gaps.text: Readings never conclude in terms of exposure (is the risk to the book higher or lower than last week, and why); no running record of verdicts.
Redeployment triggers (signed Hormuz deal, sharp oil reversal, FTSE 100 down about 10% from a recent high) are not tracked.
Holdings not mapped to risks: only three funds charted; nothing on Melrose, L&G, Greencoat, ABF, cash or gold; momentum sleeve's US tech exposure not linked.
UK inflation higher and stickier: no actual CPI (UK or US), services inflation or wage growth. Only market-implied expectations.
gaps.closed_by: 14 Oct 2026: US CPI, US core CPI, UK CPI and UK services CPI rows added to the debt block (wage growth still missing, see #20)

gaps.text: No valuation measure: no CAPE, forward P/E, top-ten concentration, or earnings yield against the real bond yield.
Corporate refinancing squeeze: no maturity wall, default or downgrade rates, lending surveys, nothing UK; credit spread is a fund price ratio proxy.
Nothing shows what is expected: no Brent futures curve, no market-implied Bank of England or Fed path.
Page says transits are published daily and lists transits, but there is no Strait of Hormuz crossings measure.

gaps.short: page text out of date (licensed series)
gaps.text: 'Still not wired in' lists Baltic Clean Tanker and NBP gas as licensed; both are on the page. 'What the proxies are' says tanker rates are proxied by owners' shares.

gaps.short: refers to sections that no longer exist
gaps.text: Page refers to sections 'Financial stress' and 'UK rates' that no longer exist.
Hyperscaler capex/depreciation as at Q1 2026, Oracle prior backlog from March; return-side figures unverified.

gaps.short: three AI rows empty; no Oracle/CoreWeave borrowing cost
gaps.text: Three AI rows empty since built (backlog conversion, lab compute share, stake gains); Oracle and CoreWeave's own borrowing costs not shown.

gaps.short: gilt auction cover typed in, no history
gaps.text: UK gilt auction cover typed in with no date or history.
30-year gilt (highest since 1998) not tracked; page stops at 20-year.

gaps.short: FTSE 100, NAV discounts, holding news absent
gaps.text: FTSE 100 level absent; discounts to NAV on preservation trusts, Greencoat and ORIT absent; holding-specific news absent.

gaps.short: news newer than the data missed
gaps.text: News search started from the data, so events newer than the data were missed.
gaps.closed_by: 9 Oct 2026: research end point (standing questions, feeds, saturation) required before a reading is shown; 14 Oct 2026: new releases detected from the data must be named in the headline

gaps.text: No calendar of what is coming.
gaps.closed_by: 14 Oct 2026: research.json must carry a dated calendar, stored in calendar.json

gaps.text: Last reading's watch items are not checked against what happened.
gaps.closed_by: 14 Oct 2026: dated calendar events that fall due must be addressed by the next reading; undated watch items are still not checked

gaps.text: Moves left unexplained (e.g. gold down 5.6% in a month with no explanation).
No UK or US wage growth measure, which decides whether inflation persists.

gaps.short: UK gilt yields lag a day or more
gaps.text: Bank of England gilt yields are published the next working day; on 14 October 2026 the newest was 12 October. US yields are now carried to the same day; UK yields are not.
